purpose: Expose Origami knowledge through bounded, model-agnostic, graph-addressed selective unfolding rather than requiring total memory to fit in model context.

address_abi.legacy_addresses: accepted inside one carrier and qualified when federated
address_abi.content_identity: CID is separate from address; multiple addresses may share one CID

graphs.local: declared links/typed edges between addressable nodes
graphs.global: derived from compact per-carrier graph signatures before local search
graphs.allowed_behavior: traverse declared edges from relevant candidates
graphs.forbidden_behavior: silently scan all exact payload when a relation or address is missing

index.reason: metadata lookup must not disguise a global exact-payload scan

context_budget.selection_objective: maximize expected utility per exposed token subject to budget
context_budget.fallback_policy: degrade requested fidelity before exceeding active budget

operations.QUERY: analyze information need, rank metadata candidates, follow only useful declared graph edges and build a ContextPacket
operations.EXPAND: open one exact address at the highest requested fidelity that fits budget
operations.SIGNATURE: expose compact carrier-level graph metadata for federation

context_packet.model_requirement: consumer only needs to understand structured/text context; Origami visual decoding is not required

federation.goal: memory scale may grow independently from active model context
